FMA70523.name: subdivision of cerebral part of internal carotid artery

FMA75865.name: trunk of branch of internal carotid artery

coordinate_system: Original BodyParts3D 4.0 whole-body XYZ, millimetres. This mesh shares the same source archive and coordinates as bodyparts3d-brain.npz. No registration, translation, rotation, mirroring or rescaling is applied. Apply the brain scene’s single common transform for display.
selection: Intracranial portions of the atlas cerebral and cerebellar arterial network, including anterior/middle/posterior cerebral arteries, communicating arteries, basilar artery and portions of paired internal carotid and vertebral arteries. Pial vessels naturally lie near the surface, as well as deeper vessels. M-suffixed geometries are included directly from the publisher archive.

excluded_parts.FJ1844: Alternate basilar representation omitted; FJ1672 is retained.
excluded_parts.FJ1657: Right anterior spinal artery omitted from brain display.
excluded_parts.FJ1657M: Left anterior spinal artery omitted from brain display.

crop_rules.method: Retain a source triangle only when all three vertices meet its inferior Z limit. Source geometry ends naturally at the last retained original triangle; no replacement cut faces or synthetic vessel ends are added.
crop_rules.rationale: The supplied vertebral arteries extend to Z=1398.41 mm and carotids to approximately 1434.5 mm. For the two carotids, vertices at Z=1490–1500 mm were about 15–26 mm from the retained brain surface, while all vertices at Z=1510–1540 mm were within approximately 8 mm. The additional carotid crop limits visible extensions into the neck.

alignment_checks.method: Computed supporting-plane distances for the 3D convex hull of the retained brain vertices and Euclidean nearest-neighbor distances to actual retained brain vertices in the common atlas frame. This audit measures display proximity; the convex hull is not an exact tissue boundary. No hull clipping is used.

integrity_checks: Every retained vertex and triangle corner was independently compared with the original OBJ bytes in the official IS-A ZIP. Corner order, absolute coordinates, all part checksums and distinct source IDs passed verification.

geometry.canonical_array_hash_definition: C-order vertices <f8, then faces <u4, then face_labels u1, concatenated without separators.
